E0217

A Cell guard is stored inside an unsupported value or captured by a lambda.

What

A Cell guard is stored inside an unsupported value or captured by a lambda.

Why

A Cell guard is a temporary loan handle. Storing it inside another value could keep the loan after its local scope ends.

Fix

Keep the guard in a local name or a tuple, and use `.map(...)` or `.split(...)` for projections.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0217: tests/ui/cell_guard_capture.stderr.

Error [E0217]: Cell guard `guard` cannot be captured by a lambda

    |
  3 |     return () -> guard.get()
    |            ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

 Fix: keep the guard in a local name or a tuple, and use `.map(...)` or `.split(...)` for projections
